verdict.rationale: xAI provides API documentation, an OpenAPI schema, and connector/tool-building docs (grok-docs-2, grok-probe-3, grok-probe-1), which supports programmatic integration, but no evidence pack item explicitly names or documents an official language SDK (e.g. Python/Node/Go client library) with install instructions or code samples. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages, SDK-specific quickstart/code examples, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
